Q: How can I customize keyboard behaviour in HTML select menus? A:

You can't change the native keyboard logic for <select> menus. There is no API or lang hint for this. The jump-to-character behavior is tied to the browser and OS locale rather than the page's lang attribute. Even with the new appearance: base-select in Chromium, the built-in keyboard behavior stays the same while the styling changes.

If you need specific Swedish A/Ä separation, I think your only real option is to replace the element with a WAI-ARIA combobox. You'll have to implement ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, and Escape yourself. But it lets you handle the collation in your own key handler.

Q: How to allow a gender field to accept only two values? A:

Your approach is good, there is only a small syntax error:

alter table Patient
   add Gender varchar(1) default 'F',
   add Check (Gender = 'M' or Gender = 'F');

The second add was missing. Using IN would be typographically shorter.

Q: Whats the difference in variable definitions A:

A child process can't change its parent's environment. When you run ./script.sh or bash script.sh, you're starting a new child shell. Any variables you export there only exist while that script is running and disappear as soon as it exits.

But when you type the commands directly into your terminal, you're working in the current shell, so the export sticks.

If you want the variable to stay after the script finishes, you need to source it:

. script.sh
# or
source script.sh

I'd use this approach whenever you need to configure your current session. Sourcing runs the commands inside your active shell instead of spawning a separate process.

Q: How to get the row average across multiple columns when some values are zero A:

In order to resolve the task, you can use CASE expression because you cannot divide by zero:

SELECT (COALESCE(q1,0) + COALESCE(q2,0) + COALESCE(q3,0) + COALESCE(q4,0)) / COALESCE((COALESCE(q1/(CASE WHEN q1 is null or q1= 0 then 1 else q1 end),0) +  COALESCE(q2/(CASE WHEN q2 is null or q2 = 0 then 1 else q2 end),0) +  COALESCE(q3/(CASE WHEN q3 is null or q3 = 0 then 1 else q3 end),0) +  COALESCE(q4/(CASE WHEN q4 is null or q4 = 0 then 1 else q4 end),0)),1)
 FROM table1

dbfiddle

It is added extra COALESCE because the sum of the divisor can be zero as well

Q: C++17: Check if constructor is ill-formed A:

For types which are not SFINAE friendly, you cannot verify that definition would produce hard error when declaration tell the method is valid.

You might do specialization for some of those unfriendly-SFINAE types and do the check yourself :-/

Q: How to return AVG of multiple columns on a single row A:

You add them up, and divide by the number of values. The exclusion of NULLs from the denominator of the average operation is a little tricky:

SELECT (IFNULL(x, 0) + IFNULL(y, 0) + IFNULL(z, 0)) /
       (IIF(ISNULL(x), 0, 1) + IIF(ISNULL(y), 0, 1) + IIF(ISNULL(z), 0, 1))
  FROM YourTable

Q: Pine script if else if A:

you made small mistake with formatting if else if expression, try to remove indents like here:

//@version=4
study("Backtest", overlay=true)
entrySource = input(title="Enter On", defval = "Buy Big Green", options=["Buy Small Green", "Buy Big Green", "Buy Big Green Div"])
exitSource = input(title="Exit On", defval = "Sell Big Red", options=["Sell Small Red", "Sell Big Red", "Sell Big Red Div"])
wtCross = true, wtCrossUp = true, wtCrossDown = true, buySignal = true, buySignalDiv = true

entry = if entrySource == "Buy Small Green"
    wtCross and wtCrossUp
else if entrySource == "Buy Big Green"
    buySignal
else if entrySource == "Sell Small Red"
    buySignalDiv
else
    na
    
exit = if exitSource == "Buy Small Green"
    wtCross and wtCrossDown
else if entrySource == "Sell Big Red"
    buySignal
else if entrySource == "Sell Small Red"
    buySignalDiv
else
    na
plot(entry ? 1 : 0)
plot(exit ? 1 : 0)
